items.text: AC1: audit tool runs end to end with one command (pnpm -F @shark/e2e audit), exits 0, outputs at stated paths, every route of the three apps in the coverage table with its screenshot set
AC2: UX-AUDIT.md has a section for each UX-A01..A15, UX-M01..M14 and each website page, every PRD 03 mandatory state evaluated
AC3: every finding in findings.json has evidence and a PRD 03/WCAG reference; validate-findings.mjs prints counts matching the report summary
AC4: contrast table covers all text and non-text tokens on all surfaces in both themes, failures flagged
AC5: keyboard walkthroughs of scenario 17 and member check-in/booking/workout (scenario 18, reduced motion) documented step by step with pass/fail
AC6: no product source files changed (diff limited to e2e/audit/**, docs/ux-audit/**, package.json script lines)
AC7: standard gates (typecheck, lint, test, build) and pnpm e2e pass
Unit tests for audit logic (contrast maths, token parser, findings validator)
PR description pr/P10.md written, scratch files removed
